launches.implementation_idea: Benchmark GPT-6 Sol against the current Hermes code-review stack on cost and latency for a week of real tasks.
launches.summary: Cheaper mid-tier GPT-6 model for coding and agentic workloads at $2/$10 per M input/output tokens.
launches.title: GPT-6 Sol
launches.usp: 50% cheaper than GPT-5.6 with faster inference via better caching, purpose-built for coding and agentic workloads.

launches.implementation_idea: Switch the Hermes reviewer agent to Opus 5.5 for a week and measure cost and quality deltas.
launches.summary: First of the Claude 5.5 family at $4/$20 per M tokens, now the default Opus in Claude Code.
launches.title: Claude Opus 5.5
launches.usp: Near-Fable 5.1 performance at ~40% lower cost and 30%+ faster than Opus 5.

launches.implementation_idea: Test Grok 4.7 on a long-horizon repo migration inside the agent stack and compare completion rates.
launches.summary: Coding and agentic model with 500K context at $2/$6 per M tokens, shipping in Cursor and the Grok API.
launches.title: Grok 4.7
launches.usp: Trained with longer RL weighted toward multi-hour tasks, with stronger self-verification and long-context management.

launches.implementation_idea: Self-host MiMo-V2.6-Flash as the local fallback model for Hermes when hosted APIs are down or rate-limited.
launches.summary: Top-ranked open-weights model on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (46); Pro is 1.02T MoE, Flash is 310B, both MIT licensed.
launches.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro / Flash
launches.usp: World's top open-weights model with 1M-token omnimodal context, MIT license, and the full RL training framework published.

launches.implementation_idea: Generate destination and hotel imagery for the VoyageBliss B2B portal using the native 2K output and multi-reference editing.
launches.summary: 7B open-weights image model with unified text-to-image generation and editing, day-0 Diffusers and ComfyUI support.
launches.title: Qwen-Image-2.1
launches.usp: Single 7B model unifying generation and editing with native 2K resolution and up to 10 reference images.

launches.implementation_idea: Run it locally as the tool-calling brain for the X DM draft pipeline to cut API spend on routine drafts.
launches.summary: 29B total / 4B active-per-token agentic MoE with 256K context, built for multi-step planning and tool calling.
launches.title: Xing4.0-29B-A4B
launches.usp: Agentic MoE that runs on a single consumer GPU yet is purpose-built for multi-step task planning and tool calling.

launches.implementation_idea: Prototype explorable 3D hotel walkthroughs for VoyageBliss B2B demos generated from listing photos.
launches.summary: Open-source model generating explorable, interactive 360-degree 3D worlds from text or image input.
launches.title: Hunyuan3D World Model 1.0
launches.usp: First open model turning a single text prompt or image into an explorable 3D world.

launches.implementation_idea: Already used for X triage; next step is wiring Jev as the go/no-go gate for Hermes deployments.
launches.summary: Transformer that outputs calibrated decision probabilities instead of text; outputs defined in advance so it cannot hallucinate.
launches.title: Jev (TypeSafe AI)
launches.usp: A non-LLM decision model: calibrated probabilities out, no text, no hallucination, output tokens free.

launches.implementation_idea: Add an Anchor-style pre-send compliance check to X DM drafts before they reach review.
launches.summary: Small LMs built as an enforcement runtime checking agent messages against regulatory and company rules before sending.
launches.title: Anchor 3.0
launches.usp: 95.5% violation recall on FINRA rules, 34x faster and 12x cheaper than GPT-5.6 Sol, under 100ms self-hosted.

launches.implementation_idea: Evaluate on-device visual reasoning for travel receipt scanning in a future VoyageBliss mobile flow.
launches.summary: 2B-parameter vision-language model in 1-bit quantization for AI smart glasses on Snapdragon AR1.
launches.title: 1-bit Bonsai
launches.usp: Fits 4x more parameters in the same memory footprint for on-device visual reasoning.

launches.implementation_idea: Use Pareto-style multi-model sampling for the highest-stakes X DM drafts where quality matters most.
launches.summary: Composite model running several models per request and keeping the best answer, via Unbiased API and OpenRouter.
launches.title: Pareto
launches.usp: Runs several models on every request and keeps the best answer, trading cost for max quality.

launches.implementation_idea: Compare AX's fleet orchestration model against the Hermes orchestrator design and borrow the Task/Workspace/Gateway abstraction.
launches.summary: Apache-2.0 declarative orchestrator for running agent fleets at scale on Kubernetes with Redis-backed state.
launches.title: AX (Agent Executor)
launches.usp: Declare Task/Workspace/Gateway/Model in YAML and run sandboxed agent workloads at fleet scale.

launches.implementation_idea: Track the Isaac Skills pattern for reusable multi-step agents applicable to travel-booking agent design.
launches.summary: GPU-accelerated robotics stack goes agentic with reusable AI agents for setup and manipulation tasks.
launches.title: Isaac ROS 5.0
launches.usp: Robotics stack rebuilt around reusable agentic skills with 5.5x faster object tracking.

launches.implementation_idea: Adopt the governance-layer concept (policy, audit, cost control) for the Hermes agent stack.
launches.summary: Open system for agentic software development spanning IDEs, team workflows, and org governance.
launches.title: JetBrains Air
launches.usp: One open system covering IDE agents, team delivery workflows, and org-level governance with audit and cost control.

launches.implementation_idea: Upgrade the tokenizer in local inference paths and measure end-to-end pipeline speedup.
launches.summary: Rebuilt default preprocessing layer for the HF ecosystem with identical token IDs.
launches.title: tokenizers v1.0.0-rc.2
launches.usp: Up to 30x faster encoding as a drop-in swap with bit-for-bit identical token IDs.

launches.implementation_idea: Prototype DNSid-style identity for Hermes subagents so every agent action is attributable to its owner.

launches.usp: Accountability that travels across orgs via DNS + PKI + immutable ledger, no bilateral trust needed.

launches.implementation_idea: Trial cindy against a standard Hermes task and compare setup friction and completion rate.
launches.summary: Open-source AI agent positioned as working out of the box: consider it done.

launches.implementation_idea: Evaluate as the desktop control plane for the local agent stack instead of chat-only operation.

launches.title: BossConsole
launches.usp: JVM-native (not Electron) console running Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and OpenCode side by side.

launches.implementation_idea: Plug into Hermes to cut context bloat across long multi-day builds.

launches.title: okf-agent-memory
launches.usp: Sub-300 microsecond in-memory BM25, pure Go, zero external DBs, claims 80% token-bloat reduction.
